1.why: My education is lower secondary so math confidence is low. I remember basic concepts but complex equations make me unsure.

2.why: Decimals were taught in early school years. I can do simple calculations but complex problems cause anxiety and hesitation.

3.why: Geometry angles were part of my school curriculum. I recall the rules but applying them correctly in tests is challenging.

4.why: Algebra is my least favorite subject. I avoided it during school and feel very unconfident solving variables or equations.

5.why: Trigonometry is completely new to me. I know nothing about sine cosine or tangent functions and feel very unconfident.

6.why: Area and volume calculations are basic math. I can handle simple shapes but complex 3D problems make me nervous.

7.why: Sketching curves requires advanced graphing skills. I did not learn this in lower secondary school and feel completely unconfident.

8.why: Fractions are a fundamental skill from primary school. I am moderately confident handling basic operations with fractions.

9.why: Finding missing sides is basic geometry. I recall the rules but applying them independently in a test is difficult.
